stdio_review.algorithm_assessment: With fixed launch speed and destination, the quadratic ballistic equation has at most two elevation solutions; the larger elevation yields a trajectory at least as high at every intermediate horizontal fraction. Test that trajectory only. Height is concave on each building intersection, so testing all grid-boundary crossings against every touching building suffices; corner events include all four roofs. Precompute crossing geometry per displacement, then BFS the directed reachability graph from the hideout. Only unvisited destinations need testing because BFS discovers minimum jump counts. Corner-adjacent grid indices use exact integer division/remainders to avoid floating-point flooring at rational corner crossings.
stdio_review.limitations: One source reviewer plus actual isolated tests, not independent dual semantic review.
